packageRules.description: MinIO AIStor uses non-semver RELEASE.<ISO8601> tags. Map year->major, month->minor, day->patch and the time as build so newer releases sort higher and Renovate proposes upgrades (free-tier license covers them; deploy minio-dev first, then minio-prd — brief S3 blip). pinDigests keeps the @sha256 in sync.

apps/cluster-agent/requirements.lock.txt is GENERATED (`uv export` of apps/cluster-agent/uv.lock) and is what the container installs. Bump the lock (pep621/uv manager), never this file: a direct bump would diverge from the lock. After a lock PR, re-export it (command in apps/cluster-agent/pyproject.toml); apps/cluster-agent/tests/test_requirements_lock.py fails until you do.
